Hi Sage — thanks for the packet, got everything. Quick checklist and next steps from our side:

1) PO / invoice mapping
- Redwood prefers invoice number + PO prefix where available. For your example wed map PO-12345 to our PO routing field; invoice number alone is OK but PO helps automated reconciliation.

2) Micro-deposits
- We will initiate a validation micro-deposit to the bank account on the onboarding form. Please confirm the exact amounts when they hit (two small deposits under $1.00). Once you confirm, well flip the vendor status from "intake" to "active" in PayOps.

3) Remittance formatting
- Your CSV sample looks great. Our payops team expects a "remit_id" column (we will provide this value on payment initiation). See attached finops-onboarding-checklist.pdf for required fields and example.

4) Timing
- Micro-deposit usually posts within 1–3 business days. After you confirm amounts, expect activation the same day. First NET30 payment will reflect standard processing windows.

Can you confirm: who should we copy on remittance emails for your accounting team (name + email)? Also confirm whether Luminex requires any special PO numbering convention for consolidated invoices.

Attachments: finops-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
